source.title: Community Feedback for WCA Bylaws
source.content:
Dear WCA Community,
 
We hereby inform you about the WCA’s endeavor to become a Nonprofit Public Benefit Corporation! Our association is on its last stages to become legally constituted and we would like to have feedback from Organizers and regular Staff of WCA Competitions, as well as other highly involved members of the WCA Community. As necessary for a Nonprofit Organization, the WCA has developed its own Bylaws. Bylaws are defined as a rule or law established by an organization or community to regulate itself, as allowed or provided for by some higher authority. In other words, the Bylaws are the WCA’s operating manual.
 
You are kindly requested to read thoroughly all the [Articles of Incorporation](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1pA7YTmYhFWa4-O1OjK72uIVvY4sb_hj_WMUyFePJOus) before proceeding to comment and give feedback. Please login and authenticate yourself before commenting or suggesting. Non identificated comments will be disregarded and removed. This is a matter of the highest importance for our future as a Nonprofit Organization. When the Bylaws get approved, they will become our initial constitution documents.
 
Best regards,
Linus Fresz, on behalf of the World Cube Association

translation.title: 征求社区对 WCA 章程的意见
translation.content:
各位 WCA 社区成员：

WCA 正在争取注册为非营利公益法人，相关法律设立程序已进入最后阶段。我们希望听取比赛组织者、经常参与 WCA 比赛的工作人员，以及其他深度参与社区的成员的意见。作为非营利组织，WCA 需要制定自己的章程。章程是在上级主管规则允许或规定的范围内，由组织或社区制定、用于规范自身运作的规则。换句话说，它就是 WCA 的运作手册。

请在评论或反馈前，仔细阅读全部[公司设立章程](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1pA7YTmYhFWa4-O1OjK72uIVvY4sb_hj_WMUyFePJOus)。发表评论或建议前，请先登录并表明身份。无法确认身份的评论将不予考虑并被删除。这对 WCA 作为非营利组织的未来至关重要。章程一旦获批，将成为我们最初的组织章程文件。

此致

Linus Fresz，代表世界魔方协会
